posts.author: TMan5636
posts.body:
So I've transferred a game made in RPG Maker MV to MZ and it's running super smoothly.
The problem I noticed is that when I type a name into the name section of a text box, it doesn't appear in the preview or the game itself.
I'm going to assume it's because it was made on MV and isn't compatible, which fair enough. But is there a way to fix this, like updating the game program to be compatible with MZ's new stuff? Or am I just gonna have to rebuild the entire game from scratch?

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: Did you update the corescript from the game menu?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Opening the project in MZ does not make it an MZ game. The project will still run the MV core scripts and therefore doesn't have any features the MZ editor makes available to you. You'd have to fully replace all the MV scripts with the MZ ones and then see how that works.
The preview doesn't show the name in the editor either way.

You sure can upgrade an MV project to MZ.
I think the easiest way is to create a fresh new MZ project, and then copy-paste img, audio, and data from the old project into the new one. The js folder shouldn't be touched, as MV and MZ have their own script files.
And I think that this is the current problem that OP has; you still have some MV-only files in your MZ project.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
fizzly said:

Click to expand...
No, you can, I've done it – you can even run your MV project from the MZ editor while it still uses the MV corescripts, if you really want to (I wouldn't usually recommend it). Though, it would have a few problems due to the fact that MZ automatically updates the data.
It's true that MV data is not 100% compatible with MZ. It's maybe 95% compatible. As others have noted, some of the system images are incompatible (ButtonSet has a different layout, Damage and Loading are no longer used; I think the rest are the same), and some of the data files are slightly incompatible (MV appends skill/stage messages to the actor or enemy's name, but MZ substitutes the name in for %1; there are a bunch of new things in System that MV knows nothing about; MZ adds several new event commands and new options for several existing event commands). But MZ will automatically update all that data for you where it's needed, other than the ButtonSet image.
Anyway, to the original poster, I suggest pressing F8 when the game freezes and see if there's anything in the console.
